activesync-tray-balloon.action: a click opens Melaton Mobile Device Center at that device (openCenter(deviceId))
activesync-tray-balloon.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize (Mobile devices popup, trayPopupHidden 'activesync'); the icon's own menu: 'Tell me when a new device needs to be set up' (NotifyOnConnect) and 'Tell me when a device's battery is low or fully charged' (NotifyBattery)
activesync-tray-balloon.note: N11 satisfied: a device connecting or leaving is never a balloon any more (the icon lights or greys, the tooltip lists devices). What is left is a call to action: a new device that waits for its setup while a primary device is set, and a phone's battery low (plug it in) or fully charged. N4: click opens Device Center. N6: popupId 'activesync' is one balloon at a time, newest wins. Needs a decision: 'Battery fully charged' is on by default (NotifyBattery defaults on).

sync-center-balloon.action: a click opens Control Panel > Sync Center on the conflicts or results page (open(view))
sync-center-balloon.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize (Sync Center popup, trayPopupHidden 'sync-center')
sync-center-balloon.note: N11 satisfied: the 'is now set up to sync' balloon is gone (the icon appearing is its own change, N2). Conflicts and errors stay: they need the user and the icon is tucked behind the chevron by default, so the balloon is the only way the condition reaches her; one balloon per rise, N6 popupId 'sync-center'.

account-subscription-renewal.area: desktop tray: Account Manager (wallet) icon balloon via the toast policy (trayIndicators.js checkSubscriptionExpiration)
account-subscription-renewal.action: a click on the balloon opens Account Manager > Status (toastManager _trayBalloonTarget)
account-subscription-renewal.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize (popup keyed by its title, trayPopupHidden); Melaton Mobile drops it and the Accounts program's Options own the renewal notice (wmAccounts, #829)
account-subscription-renewal.note: N1/N4/N5 satisfied: a renewal within 7 days is money leaving her account and she can act (open Status). Once per page session (showSubscriptionExpirationToast). Needs a decision: the wallet icon already carries the same fact as an alert row (N11), so it could drop the balloon.

account-fixed-anlas-expiring.area: desktop tray: Account Manager (wallet) icon balloon via the toast policy (trayIndicators.js checkFixedTrainingSteps)
account-fixed-anlas-expiring.action: a click on the balloon opens Account Manager > Status (toastManager _trayBalloonTarget)
account-fixed-anlas-expiring.switch: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize (popup keyed by its title, trayPopupHidden); Melaton Mobile drops it and the Accounts program raises its own
account-fixed-anlas-expiring.note: N1/N4/N5 satisfied: free Anlas about to expire is use-it-or-lose-it with a pace suggestion in the text. Once per page session and only inside the 15 day window with more than 500 left. Needs a decision: 5 minute timeout, and the wallet icon carries the same fact (N11).
